subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Why Urgency Is the Scammer's Best Tool
description: One-minute skill: Why Urgency Is the Scammer's Best Tool.

hook.text: Act now or your account will be closed. This offer expires in 10 minutes. Don't miss out.

buildup.text: Scammers manufacture urgency because rushed decisions bypass critical thinking.

discovery.text: Under time pressure, people skip verification steps they would normally follow.

twist.text: Real companies rarely demand immediate action. Urgency from strangers is almost always a red flag.

climax.text: The simplest defense: pause. Any legitimate request can wait five minutes for you to verify it.

punchline.text: If they need an answer now, the answer should be no.

quiz.question: Why do scammers create a sense of urgency?
options: It makes offers seem more valuable
